candidates.change_summary: Change the return type of decimals() from uint8 to uint256 and its signature to return uint256, causing Pool.decimals() to still compile but return a different numeric type/value when accessed via the interface.

Change the declared return type of totalSupply from uint256 to uint128 (single-statement edit in the interface declaration) so the implemented contracts will have a differing interpreted return value when called via the interface.
Replace increment of mapSynth_LPDebt with increment of mapSynth_LPBalance (causes LP balance bookkeeping to double-increment and change behavior of mapSynth_LPBalance after mintSynth).
Replace increment of mapSynth_LPDebt with no-op delete (removes debt tracking so only LP balance changes), altering mapSynth_LPBalance observed after mintSynth.
Replace the LP balance increment to use 'amount' instead of lpUnits (changes which key values increase after mintSynth).
Change onlyPool modifier to require msg.sender == DEPLOYER (restrict who can call mintSynth, altering observable effects on mapSynth_LPBalance for calls that previously succeeded).
